description.en: The full path of the object.

description.zh:
每一个上传的Part都有一个标识它的号码（partNumber）。

取值：1~10000

单个Part的大小限制为100 KB~5 GB。
>MultipartUpload事件中除最后一个Part以外，其他Part的大小都要大于或等于100 KB。因不确定是否为最后一个Part，UploadPart接口并不会立即校验上传Part的大小，只有当CompleteMultipartUpload时才会校验。
description.en:
The number that identifies each uploaded part (partNumber).

Valid values: 1 to 10000.

The size of a single part is limited to 100 KB to 5 GB.
> In a multipart upload event, all parts except the last part must be greater than or equal to 100 KB. Because it is uncertain whether a part is the last one, the UploadPart operation does not immediately validate the size of the uploaded part. The size is validated only when CompleteMultipartUpload is called.

description.zh: uploadId用于唯一标识上传的Part属于哪个Object。
description.en: The upload ID that uniquely identifies which object the uploaded part belongs to.

descriptions.zh:
- 调用UploadPart接口上传Part数据前，必须先调用InitiateMultipartUpload接口来获取OSS服务器生成的uploadId。

- 如果使用同一个partNumber上传了新的数据，则OSS上已有的partNumber对应的Part数据将被覆盖。

- OSS会将服务器端收到Part数据的MD5值放在ETag头返回给用户。

- 如果调用InitiateMultipartUpload接口时，指定了x-oss-server-side-encryption请求头，则会对上传的Part进行加密编码，并在UploadPart响应头中返回x-oss-server-side-encryption头，其值表明该Part的服务器端加密算法。更多信息，请参见[InitiateMultipartUpload](~~31992~~)。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling the UploadPart operation to upload part data, you must first call the InitiateMultipartUpload operation to obtain the upload ID generated by the OSS server.

- If you upload new data with the same part number, the existing part data corresponding to that part number in OSS is overwritten.

- OSS returns the MD5 hash of the part data received by the server in the ETag header.

- If you specified the x-oss-server-side-encryption request header when calling the InitiateMultipartUpload operation, the uploaded part is encrypted. The x-oss-server-side-encryption header is returned in the UploadPart response header, and its value indicates the server-side encryption algorithm used for the part. For more information, see [InitiateMultipartUpload](~~31992~~).
